scope: Pure CPU pose/continuity/control tests. No native input, browser composition, tree collisions or visual/FPS acceptance.

checks.name: t=0 exactly preserves actual pose without start pop
physical dt is partition independent at30/60/120Hz
nonuniform frame partitions preserve final pose
pause discards paused dt and resume has no catch-up
cancel immediately returns null and never automatically resumes
entry angular phase equals integral of smooth angular speed
entry start has vanishing pose velocity
entry/orbit join is numerically C1 and C2 away from terrain clamp
outward/antipodal look never sends target through eye
clockwise/counterclockwise modes have opposed orbital tangents
complete steady period closes the same world orbit
terrain safety matches+.5m and sea clearance without t0 jump
higher terrain clamps eye without changing target at entry join
defaults change next start but do not retime an active orbit
invalid requests fail before replacing a live run
input/output/state arrays do not leak mutable control state
callbacks only fire on start and actual cancel
long physical-time sample remains finite without absolute-time exponentials
module has no renderer/DOM/UTC/event or random dependency
